# HN's two SVG files (`hn`), for `clazel-svg`

Origin: https://news.ycombinator.com/y18.svg and https://news.ycombinator.com/triangle.svg
Fetched: 2026-11-16 (HTTP 200, `curl`), unmodified, byte for byte. These are the two SVG files that 6.1's inventory (`scripts/phase6-inventory.mjs`, phase-6.md item 6.1) found on Hacker News's front, item, login and reply pages: the logo (`y18.svg`, an `img` of 18 by 18) and the vote arrow (`triangle.svg`, a CSS `background` with `background-size: 10px`, `crates/clazel/tests/fixtures/hn/site.css`).
License: none stated by the site. Two files of 315 and 131 bytes of a public website, kept only as test inputs of the decoder written for them (item 6.11a), never shipped in the browser, as 6.1's other Hacker News fixtures.
